query: Which estimator pipeline will we use for ordinal CFA/SEM with survey weights (Mplus WLSMV vs lavaan + lavaan.survey vs ML), and what sensitivity checks will show weighting effects on loadings/paths?

response.query: Which estimator pipeline will we use for ordinal CFA/SEM with survey weights (Mplus WLSMV vs lavaan + lavaan.survey vs ML), and what sensitivity checks will show weighting effects on loadings/paths?
response.answer: For ordinal CFA/SEM with survey weights, use WLSMV in Mplus. Sensitivity checks include comparing WLSMV results with unweighted ML to observe weighting effects on loadings/paths.
